correction.priorError: v1 treated `LDB Rx,0xd0, LOOKUP[ZR]` as ROM page-0xD0 indexed CAL access.
correction.correctedSemantics: SLEIGH long-indexed: ea = RWbase + immed16. With ZR=0 and bytes `b3 01 d0 00 dest`, immed16=0x00D0 → register-file address 0x00D0 (RD0), not ROM 0xD000.
